step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows data sources on the left (E-COMM and POS) feeding into database layer (E-Comm DB and POS DB). E-Comm DB migrates to S3 via DMS, while POS DB loads into S3. From S3, Amazon EMR processes raw data to curated data lake on S3 and loads hot data to Amazon Redshift. Redshift Spectrum queries S3 data lake directly, while Athena queries historical data directly from S3.
